verdict.rationale: Edge0 runs 4-bit quantized base checkpoints and uses LoRA adapters distilled from the FP teacher to recover quantization loss. However, the evidence only shows its own bundled tier checkpoints being loaded, auto-detected from config.json, and never names FP8, GPTQ, AWQ or arbitrary third-party quantized formats. Missing for 10: documented support for FP8, GPTQ and AWQ formats, loading of external quantized checkpoints, a list of supported quantization schemes, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can load models quantized in formats like FP8, INT4, GPTQ, or AWQ

citations.quote: recovering most of the quantization loss at 4-bit
